paper.title_en: No-Go Theorem for Phantom Crossing in Scalar-Tensor Gravity with Non-Minimal Derivative Coupling and Soft Scale-Invariance Breaking
paper.abstract_en: Recent baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI 2024) reveal a preference for dynamical dark energy with an equation of state parameter crossing the phantom divide ($w < -1$) at low redshifts. We investigate whether this phantom crossing can be realized within scale-invariant scalar-tensor theories featuring non-minimal derivative coupling (NMDC) between the scalar field and the Einstein tensor. Employing the effective field theory of dark energy formalism, we systematically derive the ghost-free and gradient stability conditions, and examine their compatibility with the swampland conjectures from quantum gravity. We establish three rigorous no-go theorems demonstrating that: (i)~phantom crossing necessitates $ξ_{\text{eff}} < 0$, directly violating the no-ghost stability requirement $ξ_{\text{eff}} > 0$; (ii)~the swampland de Sitter and distance conjectures independently obstruct phantom crossing; and (iii)~these theoretical obstructions are mutually reinforcing. Our results show that scale-invariant NMDC models cannot account for the DESI preference for $w < -1$, providing robust theoretical guidance for dark energy model building beyond this class.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在标量-张量理论（含非最小导数耦合）框架下系统研究幻影穿越的实现条件，推导出避免鬼场与梯度的稳定性条件，并与swampland猜想结合建立三个no-go定理，直接回应DESI 2024对w<-1的偏好。理论深度高、论证结构清晰，属于修改引力方向的高价值文献，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 具有非最小导数耦合与软标度不变性破缺的标量-张量引力中幻影穿越的no-go定理
decision.abstract_zh: 近期来自暗能量光谱仪（DESI 2024）的重子声学振荡测量显示，暗能量倾向于动力学暗能量，其状态方程参数在低红移处穿越幻影分界（$w < -1$）。我们研究这种幻影穿越能否在具有标量场与爱因斯坦张量之间非最小导数耦合（NMDC）的标度不变标量-张量理论中实现。利用暗能量有效场论形式，我们系统推导无鬼场与梯度稳定性条件，并考察其与来自量子引力的swampland猜想的兼容性。我们建立三个严格的no-go定理，证明：(i)~幻影穿越要求 $ξ_{\text{eff}} < 0$，直接违反无鬼场稳定性要求 $ξ_{\text{eff}} > 0$；(ii)~swampland de Sitter猜想与距离猜想各自独立地阻碍幻影穿越；(iii)~这些理论障碍彼此相互强化。我们的结果表明，标度不变NMDC模型无法解释DESI对 $w < -1$ 的偏好，为此类之外暗能量模型的构建提供了稳健的理论指导。
